english_lines: At the very thought, joy swells—and my
O Jayadhira, before whom great heroes bow,
Your fame has no equal in this world. (என்)
At the auspicious evening hour, taking the garland, I
Will place it upon my beloved Mohan.
notes: `ஜெயதீரா` is preserved as the source vocative/name rather than replaced by an inferred modern form.

english_lines: With joy I will embrace him to my breast,
United in life, I will forever know happiness. (என்)

translator_notes: The marriage/garland imagery and repeated source cue `(என்)` are preserved.
